  compliance_lawyer: Certification doesn't grandfather — any DOL reinterpretation triggers re-audit and the supplier's prior approval voids unless they affirmatively re-qualify under the new standard.   trade_credit_underwriter: Auto_strategy, I need to know: of your Tier 2 and Tier 3 suppliers eating that 8–12% cost or the $340M re-qual, which ones are already margin-thin or leveraged? I want to walk the CFO in with a single plan — which tier do we de-risk first, and what's the non-negotiable decision date to avoid the hard reset? That's what turns this into something we can actually execute.

  supplier: Tier 2 nearshoring I can absorb — my mid-volume suppliers have some cushion, maybe 60–70% can eat the 8–12% hit without folding.
